POS System for Multi-Branch Retail Chains

Xilnex Classic POS for Retail is a cloud-based point-of-sale system for multi-branch retailers across Southeast Asia. It handles checkout, real-time inventory across stores, supplier management, and integrates with food ordering platforms such as ShopeeFood and GrabFood, and keeps working offline when the internet drops.

Book a Demo See what it does

  • ShopeeFood & GrabFoodOrders land against one catalogue
  • ISO/IEC 27001:2022Certified by IRQS under NABCB
  • e-Invoice readyLHDN submission, included at no cost

Our features

Five parts of the system a multi-branch retailer touches every day.

Stock that reflects every store, now

Levels, transfers and stock counts move between branches and warehouses in real time, so variance surfaces while you can still act on it rather than at the next stocktake.

  • Live stock across stores and warehouses
  • Branch-to-branch transfers with an audit trail
  • Supplier and purchase order management
  • Cycle counts that do not close the shop

The till does not stop

Checkout keeps processing during an internet outage and pushes the queued sales up automatically once the line returns, so a dropped connection is an inconvenience rather than a closed store.

  • Sales continue through an outage
  • Automatic sync on reconnect, no re-keying
  • Split payments, returns and exchanges
  • One price list, published from head office

Delivery orders land in the same system

Orders from platforms such as ShopeeFood and GrabFood arrive in the POS against the same product catalogue the counter uses, so online and in-store sales draw down the same stock.

  • ShopeeFood and GrabFood integration
  • One catalogue behind every channel
  • Delivery orders visible to the branch
  • Channel performance reported side by side

One figure for the group, and every figure behind it

Sales, margin and stock movement are reported per store and consolidated for the group, so head office is not rebuilding the day in a spreadsheet each evening.

  • Consolidated group sales, per-store detail
  • Margin and basket analysis by outlet
  • Stock movement and shrinkage reporting
  • Scheduled reports to the people who act on them

Certified, and compliant where it counts

Information security is held to ISO/IEC 27001:2022, certified by IRQS under NABCB accreditation. e-Invoice submission to LHDN is built into the POS and included at no additional cost.

  • ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certified
  • Issued by IRQS under NABCB accreditation
  • e-Invoice / LHDN compliance built in, free
  • Role and permission control per outlet
